description: Resume a Contextium project from a session handoff — loads the project plan, finds the last handoff note, and briefs you so you can continue without losing context. Call this when the user says things like: "resume my project", "continue where I left off", "pick up from last session", "what was I working on", "I'm back let's continue", "carry on from yesterday", "what's next in my project".

workflowId.description: Workflow ID to resume (optional — if omitted, auto-selects if only one workflow exists)

name: resume_project
